summary.name: Monitoring (Wikipedia disambiguation)
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia disambiguation page listing the many meanings of "monitoring" across science, technology, and other fields.
use_cases: finding the right meaning of the term monitoring
looking up network or system monitoring concepts
researching environmental or medical monitoring terms
summary.what_it_does: This is a disambiguation page, not a tool or product. It lists various meanings of the word "monitoring" grouped by field: biology and healthcare, computing, environmental science, other science and engineering uses, and miscellaneous uses. Each entry is a one-line definition with a link to a dedicated article. It also includes a see-also section pointing to Monitor and Surveillance.
notable: Covers computing terms such as network monitoring, system monitoring, and website monitoring
Organized by field, from healthcare to environmental science
Lists a 2024 song titled Monitoring by Deco*27 featuring Hatsune Miku
caveats: Not a software tool; it only defines the term and links to other articles
Does not describe any specific monitoring product
